_comment: EXAMPLE / PLACEHOLDER only. Copy to runpod-trellis-workflow.json or point RUNPOD_WORKFLOW_PATH at a real Comfy API export. Do not reuse unrelated project endpoints. Photos are injected at submit time — never put size-chart data here.
_export_howto: 1. Finish photo→GLB on a ComfyUI session that matches the worker custom_nodes + weights
2. Menu: Save (API Format) / Export (API) — UI workflow JSON will not work with worker-comfyui
3. Overwrite config/runpod-trellis-workflow.json OR set RUNPOD_WORKFLOW_PATH / RUNPOD_WORKFLOW_JSON
4. Keep LoadImage wired for app injection (placeholder name INPUT_IMAGE_0 in this example)
5. Rename _meta.title so it no longer contains 'placeholder' / 'edit to match'
6. npm run dry-run:runpod → expect placeholderNodes false before --live-ping

_runpod_comfy_hints.typical_payload: POST /v2/{endpointId}/run  body: { input: { workflow, images, photo_only, ... } }
_runpod_comfy_hints.worker: Often runpod-worker-comfy or a custom handler that accepts workflow + image URLs
_runpod_comfy_hints.glb_output: Stock handler may ignore SaveGLB history keys — wire glb_s3_upload / custom handler for https glb_url

_meta.title: TRELLIS.2 Image → 3D (placeholder class_type — replace with your installed custom node)
